scope: One existing DEV contact diagnosis and one preregistered local fork; no new conditions.

precontact.alignment: Nearest actual centerline-progress states; not matching timestep
precontact.conclusion: Speed, lateral position, heading, target and steering differ before first damage. Speed-only attribution is not identified.

counterfactual.single_change: From act177, supply oldHUD as pedal_speed; preserve all other policy laws and original reset/history.
counterfactual.passage_criterion: Centerline progress10m beyond the focus obstacle, evaluated only outside the actor
counterfactual.interpretation: The local pedal-feedback change prevented recorded contact while passing the obstacle. It also changed downstream observations, path and steering; no independently isolated planner cause or general safety/lap claim.
counterfactual.clearance_caveat: Saved fixture-polygon minima use different precontact windows and omit raw contact/skin/impulse details. No monotone clearance-improvement claim.

budget.capacity_policy: Set a prospective campaign N using measured serial throughput, actual setup/analysis needs and session/deadline capacity. If needed, record B>=cumulative_native+84000+N before launch. Remaining authorization is not assumed to be continuous runtime.

next_experiment_proposal.policy: Use oldHUD for pedals only while the unchanged existing near-hazard predicate is true; use frozen fixed-decoder pedals otherwise. No new threshold/gain/ROI.
next_experiment_proposal.comparison: One paired DEV experiment, two fresh conditions, three arms:113 champion,116 frozen HUD candidate, and near-gated candidate.
next_experiment_proposal.gate: Qualify the single changed path and freeze artifact/conditions first; use existing completion-first and paired-time decision, with damage reported separately. No new damage-acceptance threshold or promotion here.
next_experiment_proposal.status: PROPOSED_ONLY; no next-stage candidate execution or B increase in118

reproduction: Generic observer, saved-input replayer, one-prefix intervention worker and paired runner are public. Private seed/settings/records and original documents remain outside this repository.
